en: Effects of Audio on Mental Abilities
Welcome to the study Effects of Audio on Mental Abilities.
In this study you will first listen to an audio track (either music, speech or silence) for about 10 minutes.
Subsequently, you will be asked to complete a cognitive task for another 10 minutes.
In addition, we will ask you a few questions about your socio-demographic background.
Note that participating in this study is voluntary and that you can terminate the study at any point without any negative consequences.
